data.long_meaning: The name Chadd is of Anglo-Saxon origin, derived from the Old English word 'ceadu' which means 'warrior'. In the Old Testament, the name Cadda is given to a son born to Jabin, the king of Hazor, making Chadd a name with both Christian and biblical roots. The name Chadd carries the meaning “Brave warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Chadd usually hope their child will grow to embody brave warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
